subtopics.title: Section A: Objective Items, Answered and Explained

questions.question: The withdrawal of money from the circular flow through savings, taxes and imports is known as:
Give-the-term items refuse abbreviations, so the correct answer for 'the rolling three-year expenditure plan of government' is:
options: The Medium Term Expenditure Framework, written out in full

questions.question: A deliberate lowering of a currency's value under a FIXED exchange rate system is called:
The economists who explain business cycles by forces INSIDE the economy are the:

subtopics.title: Short Items: Banking the First Marks of Every Question

questions.question: Name TWO instruments of monetary policy. A full-mark pair is:
options: The repo rate and open market transactions

questions.question: What effect will a depreciation of the rand have on exports? The two-mark answer is:
options: Exports become cheaper in foreign currency, so export volumes increase

questions.question: The right length for a two-mark short answer is:
options: One or two lines — proportion follows the mark allocation

subtopics.title: Data Response: Reading a Business Cycle Diagram

questions.question: On the cycle diagram, point A at the bottom of the dip is the:
The trend line on a business cycle diagram shows:
options: The long-term average path of economic growth through the cycles

questions.question: Distance X between the crest and the trend line measures:
options: The amplitude — how intensely activity swings from the trend

questions.question: Inflation pressure is greatest at the peak because:
options: Government always cuts taxes at the peak
Spending presses against full capacity, so excess demand pulls prices up

subtopics.title: Data Response: A Balance of Payments Table

questions.question: In the table, earnings from foreign tourists visiting South Africa appear under:
Goods exports 1 200, net gold exports 100, merchandise imports 1 400. The trade balance is:
With total receipts of 1 650, total payments of 1 850 and net transfers of minus 50, the current account balance is:
options: Minus 250 million — a current account deficit

questions.question: A valid correction of a current account deficit is:
options: Lowering interest rates to push capital out
Fixing the rand permanently to the dollar
Raising interest rates to attract foreign capital and promoting exports

subtopics.title: The Eight-Mark Paragraphs: Middle and Higher Order

questions.question: An eight-mark paragraph question is built from:
options: Four developed facts at two marks each, or a described graph plus explanation

questions.question: On the Laffer curve, tax revenue is zero at BOTH extremes because:
options: At nought percent nothing is collected, and at one hundred percent working loses all reward

questions.question: Crowding out weakens expansionary fiscal policy because:
options: Public borrowing pushes interest rates up, squeezing private investment

questions.question: In higher-order paragraphs, merely listing textbook headings earns:
options: At most one mark per bare fact — development in context earns the second mark

subtopics.title: The Essay, Built Live: Smoothing of Business Cycles

questions.question: The fixed mark allocation of the Economics essay is:
options: Introduction 2, main body 26, additional part 10, conclusion 2 — total 40

questions.question: To smooth a DOWNSWING, the correct policy pairing is:
options: Raise the repo rate and raise taxes
Lower the repo rate, raise government spending and cut taxes

questions.question: The introduction earns its two marks by:
options: Announcing what the essay will discuss
Repeating the question word for word
Defining the main concept cleanly without borrowing the question's wording

questions.question: A strong ten-mark additional part on demand-side policy would argue that:
options: Lags, the Phillips trade-off, supply shocks and debt costs all limit smoothing — so demand policy works best paired with supply-side reform

subtopics.title: The Second Essay Option and Final Marking Wisdom

questions.question: The flagship development corridor linking South Africa to a neighbouring port economy is the:
Coega, East London and Richards Bay are examples of:
options: Industrial Development Zones tied to ports, extended later by Special Economic Zones

questions.question: The command verb 'evaluate' requires you to:
options: Give a substantiated judgement of your own on successes and failures

questions.question: Choosing between Section B questions, the smart criterion is:
options: Avoid any question with a table
Choose the questions whose DATA topics you know best — data response and paragraphs carry most of the marks
